  AND ((c.customer_city = 'rio de janeiro' AND c.customer_state = 'RJ') OR (c.customer_city = 'sao paulo' AND c.customer_state = 'SP'))

{"sql": "WITH g AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr,
         sum(i.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017,2018)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT gmv FROM g WHERE yr=2017) AS gmv_2017,
  (SELECT gmv FROM g WHERE yr=2018) AS gmv_2018,
  round(((SELECT gmv FROM g WHERE yr=2018) - (SELECT gmv FROM g WHERE yr=2017)) / (SELECT gmv FROM g WHERE yr=2017) * 100, 2) AS growth_pct"}

{"sql": "WITH cc AS (
  SELECT p.payment_installments AS inst
  FROM order_payments p
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  WHERE p.payment_type = 'credit_card'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
)
SELECT inst AS mode_installments,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cc) AS total_cc_records,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cc), 4) AS share_pct
FROM cc
GROUP BY inst
ORDER BY cnt DESC, inst
LIMIT 5;"}

{"sql": "WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_estimated_delivery_date
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_status='delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
), seller_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id, q2.order_id, q2.order_delivered_customer_date, q2.order_estimated_delivery_date
  FROM q2 JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=q2.order_id
), agg AS (
  SELECT seller_id,
         count(*) AS measured_orders,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date) AS late_orders,
         100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)/nullif(count(*),0) AS late_pct
  FROM seller_orders GROUP BY seller_id
)
SELECT seller_id, measured_orders, late_orders, late_pct
FROM agg WHERE measured_orders >= 50
ORDER BY late_pct DESC, seller_id
LIMIT 10;"}

{"sql": "WITH o AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, count(oi.order_item_id) AS items
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT count(*) AS orders_with_items,
       sum(items) AS total_items,
       round(avg(items), 4) AS avg_items,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE items >= 2) AS multi_item_orders,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE items >= 2) / count(*), 4) AS multi_item_pct
FROM o;"}
